description:
Read one weekly whale-activity report snapshot. Pass either from/to UTC dates or an ISO YYYY-WW week token.

Args:
  - week (string, optional): YYYY-WW selector
  - from/to (string, optional): UTC dates in YYYY-MM-DD format

Returns: Report snapshot metadata and entries.

from.description: UTC source-range start in YYYY-MM-DD format

to.description: UTC source-range end in YYYY-MM-DD format

week.description: ISO week selector in YYYY-WW format

name: get_weekly_report_snapshot
title: Get Weekly Report Snapshot
